svg.title: Get Anubis. It’s free.
svg.desc: A free browser extension to hide unwanted search results and raise trusted sites. Scan the Chrome or Firefox QR code to open its official store listing.

g.text: Hide junk websites. Raise the sites you trust.
Works on Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, and more.
No account. No data collected by the developer.
Scan to add it to your browser.
